713:t_019:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$... If you run into $$ガイオウ$$, pass this on for me.」

713:t_019:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That we're standing up to a future of despair.」

713:t_020:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I... couldn't atone for the lives I took...」

713:t_020:1.en:
$n
「The people who died aren't here anymore...」

713:t_020:2.en:
$n
「Atoning to those people matters too... But if you call yourself a general, you should have looked for what you could do for the people who are still alive.」

713:t_020:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... Is that the answer you came up with, beyond both hope and despair...」

713:t_020:4.en:
$n
「...I don't know if it's an answer, though...」

713:t_020:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... The $$悲しみの乙女$$, the $$傷だらけの獅子$$, the $$揺れる天秤$$...」

713:t_020:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Anyone will do. Take my four $$スフィア$$s. You who have achieved $$真化融合$$ should be able to.」

713:t_020:7.en:
$n
「...How am I supposed to do that to someone who's lost the will to fight...」

713:t_021:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The cursed wanderer, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... Were you drawn here by the $$スフィア$$s too?」

713:t_021:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$. I'll carry on your feelings myself.」

713:t_021:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's dirty, $$アサキム$$! You're gonna snatch his $$スフィア$$s out from under us!?」

713:t_021:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「If it's to take my revenge on them, I'll do anything, even scavenge off corpses.」

713:t_021:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「As long as you defeat the $$御使い$$s, either of you is fine. I leave what comes after to you.」

713:t_022:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「This is what happens.」

713:t_023:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I've taken back your four $$スフィア$$s.」

713:t_023:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$喜びのアドヴェント$$...!」

713:t_023:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アウストラリス$$... $$アドナキエル$$ the General...」

713:t_023:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「In consideration of your achievements until now, I took your life so that you wouldn't suffer.」

713:t_023:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Farewell, $$アドナキエル$$.」

713:t_023:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Don't call me by that name!」

713:t_023:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am... the $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$!!」

713:t_024:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You seem displeased, $$アサキム$$.」

713:t_024:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But this is a rightful act. After all, we are the original owners of the $$スフィア$$s.」

713:t_024:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That arrogance... I can't forgive it.」

713:t_025:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「A wise decision. He knows his own strength.」

713:t_025:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「At any rate, this means the four $$スフィア$$s have come back to us.」

713:t_025:2.en:
$n
「So you came back, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

713:t_025:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I frightened you earlier, $n.」

713:t_025:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But rest assured. I will never abandon you.」

713:t_025:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't think of us as your property!」

713:t_025:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is not limited to just the two of you.」

713:t_025:8.en:
$n
「Are you planning to fight us with the power of those $$スフィア$$s?」

713:t_025:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You really don't understand anything, $n.」

713:t_025:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The $$スフィア$$s are not a power meant for fighting. They exist to save this universe.」

713:t_025:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll be waiting for you, $c. To save the entire universe, your power is needed too.」

713:t_026:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's no use, $n. He warped out to retreat.」

713:t_026:2.en:
$$桂$$
「But showing himself in front of us was his mistake.」

713:t_026:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「Judging by today's battle, the $$御使い$$ of Sorrow clearly has a different purpose from Advent and the others.」

713:t_026:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If so, is she on our side...」

713:t_026:5.en:
$n
「We can sort it all out at their home base.」

713:t_026:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, return at once. We'll follow the trail of the $$烙印$$ and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and chase him by warp as well.」

713:t_026:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just you wait, $$御使い$$s! We won't hesitate or waver anymore!」

713:t_026:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The possibility within us... All we can do is believe in it and fight...!」

713:t_026:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「Now it's our turn to storm into your place! We'll pay you back for everything so far!」

713:t_026:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
(So long, $$ヴィルダーク$$... I still can't accept you, after all...)

713:t_026:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
(But I'll grant your wish, and $$尸空#pilot$$'s too. By taking those guys down.)

713:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn it... damn it...! Our fight wasn't for nothing, was it!」

713:t_100:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Dad, Grandpa, Big Bro Ichi! I... I...!!」

713:t_101:0.en:
$$万丈$$
(This helplessness... It's the same as the day I fled Mars...)

713:t_101:1.en:
$$万丈$$
(Am I going to be devoured by despair like this...?)

713:t_102:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I've gotten through pinches like this plenty of times before! This time too... for sure!」

713:t_102:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Damn it! So why am I this scared!? Somebody, tell me!!」

713:t_103:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I can't give up! If I give up, even $$鉄人$$ can't fight!」

713:t_103:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「This is exactly when I have to muster my courage...! So why...!」

713:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Light is born where there is hope...! If we're swallowed by despair, that's the end!」

713:t_104:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「We have to overcome this despair! Otherwise it's over for me and for Earth!」

713:t_105:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「My gut is telling me...! This is a different beast from any of the tight spots we've been through!」

713:t_105:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Can't we win...!? Against these guys, or against fate...!」

713:t_106:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「The darkness in my heart is about to crush me completely...!」

713:t_106:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Tell me, Brother...! What... what should I... what should we do...!?」

713:t_107:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「My body and heart just won't fire up... Is this what despair is...!」

713:t_107:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Is this the end for us... for me, in a place like this...!」

713:t_108:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Even facing a horde of $$宇宙怪獣$$, I never felt like this...」

713:t_025:3: 脅かして = 'frightened' (Advent's earlier attack on the fleet)
